spec_proposals: SENT-SD-1 next/previous page number: Studio reads document page order (the page after / before the page holding the line). The jump-line reading (page of the next / previous frame of the thread) is the other candidate; the spec should state which. Vendor UNVERIFIED (D5)

SENT-SD-2 index marker: the spec states no displayed value; layout returns typed marker_rule_unstated (shaped as nothing). Proposal: state that the index marker composes as empty (zero width) and resolves only for the index generator

SENT-SD-3 odd/even-page break: parity read as the page NUMBER from the section numbering (not page side, not document ordinal); the spec states no blank-page insertion, so none is inserted and frames of the wrong parity are passed over (skipped_frames). Proposal: state the parity source and whether a blank page is inserted

SENT-SD-4 break without a target (no later column, frame or page): Studio oversets from the break byte (the break itself and everything after it), also when the break ends the story. Proposal: state overset vs ignore at story end

SENT-SD-5 flush space: 'fully justified last line' read as the last line of a justify-all-lines paragraph only; on the last line of a justify-last-left paragraph and on every other line it has no width; several flush spaces on one line share the slack equally. Proposal: state these three cases

SENT-SD-6 explicit unresolved state: layout reports it (MarkerOutcome.state, typed codes) and shapes nothing; the visible indicator belongs to a GUI lane (spec: 'shows an explicit unresolved state'). Proposal: state the visual form

SENT-SD-7 marker resolution that does not settle (a resolved number that pushes its own line to another page): spec silent; Studio refuses markers_unstable after max_passes (default 4). Proposal: state the rule

SENT-SD-8 section marker of a section without marker text: STU-TYP-207 says unresolved (layout: marker_no_section_marker); the running-text variable reading in running.rs resolves it as empty. The two readings should be reconciled in the spec

SENT-SD-9 flush space as a break opportunity: Type's CompositionFlags reading says break_opportunity true; layout's UAX #14 classifies U+FDDD as XX (no break) and does not break there. The spec should state it; if it is an opportunity, layout needs a rule change
